description: In collapse_by_thread (email.rs:1654-1665), when an email id is in the query result but not in the thread_map (e.g. concurrent delete between query and fetch), the code includes the email unconditionally (result.push(id)). This email may still be in the same thread as an already-included email, causing collapseThreads to return duplicate thread representatives. Trigger: concurrent delete of an email between query_objects and get_objects calls inside collapse_by_thread → two emails from the same thread both appear in collapsed results.
title: collapse_by_thread silently includes emails whose threadId is missing from fetch result
